_comment: Third-party AI applications Datas can install and open for the user. Each runs in its own isolated Python environment (managed with uv) inside <data>/apps/<id>; Datas only installs, starts, stops and shows them — it does not change what they do. Users can add their own recipes as JSON files in <data>/apps.d/. Facts verified against each project's repository at the pinned tag (2026-11-09).

apps.name: ComfyUI
apps.plain_en: The full workshop for making and editing images and video: text→video, picture→video, video→video, replacing or repainting parts of a video (a label, a bottle, a background), upscaling, and hundreds of community add-ons. Powerful; it shows ready-made templates to start from.
apps.plain_es: El taller completo para crear y editar imágenes y video: texto→video, imagen→video, video→video, reemplazar o repintar partes de un video (una etiqueta, una botella, un fondo), mejorar resolución y cientos de complementos de la comunidad. Potente; trae plantillas listas para empezar.
apps.supports: Wan 2.1/2.2, LTX-Video, HunyuanVideo, CogVideoX, Mochi; Stable Diffusion, SDXL, Flux, Qwen Image and Qwen Image Edit, Z-Image and more (per its README)

apps.name: FaceFusion
apps.plain_en: Changes faces in photos and videos: put a face on another person (face swap), make lips follow a new audio track (lip-sync, for dubbing), restore or sharpen faces, change expression or age, remove the background, colourise and upscale frames.
apps.plain_es: Cambia caras en fotos y videos: poner una cara en otra persona (face swap), hacer que los labios sigan un audio nuevo (lip-sync, para doblaje), restaurar o mejorar caras, cambiar expresión o edad, quitar el fondo, colorear y mejorar cuadros.
apps.supports: processors in the pinned version: face_swapper, deep_swapper, lip_syncer, face_enhancer, face_editor, expression_restorer, age_modifier, background_remover, frame_enhancer, frame_colorizer
